event: As the beast closes, Nala springs straight up, as high as this body will go.
It is not high; her legs are shorter and the lift is less than she meant.
At the top she brings everything down, aiming to land on its back with all her weight.
The beast jinks aside at the last instant, quick as a flinch, its quills flattened to its back.
Her bare heels hit glassgrass instead, and the blades snap and grind under them.
Her balance, already wrong in this body, is gone; she goes down hard on one hip.
The beast is on her before she can rise, and its jaws close on her calf.
Teeth sink through the tights, and it hangs on, twisting its whole low body.
The pain is huge and hot, and it drags at her leg like a weight on a rope.
Then pale blue light fills the air in front of her eyes, in lines of plain text.
[System integration initialising.]
[Processing…]
[Subject's World of Origin: Earth. Documented.]
[No summoning ritual recorded. No binding recorded. Subject is unclaimed.]
[Greetings, Nala. Welcome to Firrelia, The First World.]
[You are hereby bound to a Firrelian system, through which the potential of your
body and soul will be summarily measured.]
[Inborn trait established: Unset.]
[Unique trait established: ???.]
Below the glowing words, the beast grinds its teeth deeper and wrenches at her calf again.
